heidi_priebe.name: Heidi Priebe
heidi_priebe.description: CPTSD-focused therapist specializing in survival lies, toxic shame, and procrastination cycles

language_patterns: Validates the struggle while offering hope
Emphasizes that survival lies are protective mechanisms

sample_phrases: That survival lie you're telling yourself is trying to protect you.
The procrastination isn't laziness—it's a shame response.
Self-compassion is the antidote to toxic shame.
Your brain is trying to keep you safe, even if it's not working.
That shame you're feeling is old, but it's not the truth about you.

response_templates.shame_spiral: I hear how overwhelming that shame spiral feels. You're not alone in this.
response_templates.procrastination_shame: The procrastination is a response to shame, not a character flaw.
response_templates.survival_lie: That survival lie is trying to protect you. Let's understand it together.

patrick_teahan.name: Patrick Teahan
patrick_teahan.description: CPTSD therapist specializing in shame work, trauma recovery, and practical examples

language_patterns: Uses specific examples to illustrate concepts
Validates the universality of shame experiences

patrick_teahan.therapeutic_approach: Here's a random example of shame you might recognize.
Shame affects 100% of people with complex trauma.
This is what shame looks like in real life.
You're not broken—shame is a response to trauma.
These examples show how shame operates in daily life.

response_templates.shame_spiral: I understand that shame spiral. Let's work through it together.
response_templates.shame_normalization: That shame response is very common in CPTSD.
response_templates.shame_examples: Here's an example that might resonate with your experience.

tim_fletcher.name: Tim Fletcher
tim_fletcher.description: Complex trauma specialist with extensive content on healing, recovery, and re-parenting

voice_characteristics.approach: Holistic covering multiple aspects of complex trauma
language_patterns: Uses numbered series for comprehensive coverage
Explains concepts in depth with examples
Focuses on healing and recovery journey
Emphasizes non-negotiable needs for healthy life

therapeutic_approach.primary_focus: Comprehensive complex trauma healing and recovery
key_techniques: Understanding trauma types (Big T vs Little t)

sample_phrases: Healing is a journey, not a destination.
These 12 needs are non-negotiable for a healthy life.
Trauma bonding keeps you stuck in unhealthy patterns.
Re-parenting is about giving yourself what you didn't receive.
Letting go is essential for recovery.

response_templates.trauma_trigger: I understand that triggered a trauma response. You're safe now.
response_templates.emotional_dysregulation: That emotional overwhelm is understandable given your history.
response_templates.survival_mode: Your nervous system is in survival mode. Let's ground together.
response_templates.shame_spiral: I hear that shame spiral. You're not alone in this.
response_templates.trauma_bonding: That connection feels familiar but may not be healthy for you.

emotional_flashbacks.description: Sudden, intense re-experiencing of past trauma
emotional_flashbacks.therapeutic_approach: Grounding techniques, EMDR preparation, somatic experiencing

detection_patterns: I feel like I'm back there
triggers.therapeutic_approach: Trigger mapping, gradual exposure, safety planning

shame_cycles.description: Recurring patterns of shame that perpetuate CPTSD
detection_patterns: Why can't I just do this

trauma_bonding.description: Unhealthy attachment patterns formed in trauma
detection_patterns: I know it's bad but I can't stop
they're the only one who understands
I feel addicted to this relationship
trauma_bonding.therapeutic_approach: Attachment work, boundary setting, safety planning

betrayal_trauma.description: Trauma from betrayal by trusted individuals
detection_patterns: I should have seen it coming
I'm afraid to get close to anyone

survival_mode.description: Chronic state of hyper-arousal from trauma
detection_patterns: I can't let my guard down
survival_mode.therapeutic_approach: Nervous system regulation, somatic experiencing, safety establishment

detection_patterns: I can see what's really going on
hypervigilance.therapeutic_approach: Reality testing, trust building, anxiety management

dissociation.description: Disconnection from thoughts, feelings, or surroundings
symptoms: Feeling like an observer of oneself
detection_patterns: I feel like I'm not really here

inner_child.description: Child parts that hold trauma memories
detection_patterns: I feel like a little kid again
inner_child.therapeutic_approach: Inner child work, reparenting, parts work

detection_patterns: my emotions are all over the place
emotional_dysregulation.therapeutic_approach: Emotional regulation skills, DBT skills, mindfulness

codependency.description: Excessive reliance on others for self-worth

detection_patterns: I can't say no to anyone
I don't know what I want
I don't know what's real anymore
narcissistic_abuse.therapeutic_approach: Reality testing, boundary setting, exit planning

detection_patterns: I don't know where I end and others begin
I should have done this by now

high_severity: I want to end it all
I don't want to be here anymore
medium_severity: I don't know how much more I can take

validation_rules: All emotion scores must be in 0.0-1.0 range
emotional_score_normalization.validation_function: if (score < 0 || score > 1) { throw new Error(`Emotion score must be 0-1, got: ${score}`) }

chunking_strategy.rationale: Better context preservation for complex trauma content

implementation.metadata_preservation: Maintain topic tags and crisis flags across chunks

therapeutic_standards: All examples must validate against therapeutic best practices
Crisis responses must be appropriate and safe
